summary:
APPROVE — single-attempt code review of attempt #5 (fix /subconscious/search-context daemon event-loop wedge), commit f7a5aea5.

ROOT CAUSE VERIFIED REAL (not a band-aid): the multi-round agentic loop in lib/subconscious/index.js (while round<=max_rounds, ~L579-602) drives memorySearch→rerank() once per round (lib/search/memory-search.js:650). Pre-fix lib/rerank.js/embed.js deduped spawns only on a PID file the child writes seconds late, so back-to-back cold-start rerank()s each spawned a fresh ~80MB model-loader → CPU saturation → daemon event-loop starvation. Fix is squarely in the sidecar spawn path (cooldown latch in lib/rerank.js+lib/embed.js; EADDRINUSE bind-race guard in lib/rerank-server.js+lib/embed-server.js), NOT a timeout bolted onto routes/subconscious.js.

CORRECTNESS: independently reproduced the negative control — pre-fix 24-call burst spawns 24 sidecars (assertion FAILS); post-fix collapses to 1 spawn (PASSES). Cooldown is a strict-< 30s window that REOPENS after elapse (verified by source + reasoning), and the PID-file isRunning(pid) liveness short-circuit runs after the gate, so a healthy sidecar is still detected as running and a crashed one respawns on the next call past 30s — bounded, never a permanent block; single-spawn-comes-up-once is preserved. Bind-race logic sound: pidAlive() gates the stale-socket unlink so a race loser can't delete the winner's live socket; loser hits EADDRINUSE and exit(0) BEFORE loading the model without calling cleanup() (winner owns files). embed-server guard correctly placed inside require.main before server.listen.

TEST QUALITY: genuine negative control, not a smoke test. PART1 asserts <=1 spawn under a cold-start burst (I confirmed it fails on pre-fix code = 24 spawns, passes on fix). PART2 asserts all 6 rapid search-context calls return AND a 25ms health-probe maxLag stays <750ms (measured 63ms) — a real event-loop-responsiveness check (the wedge signature). Full regression test 10/10 on the attempt tree.
